integrity: Proof and independently replayable symbolic/numerical verification are supplied. Finite numerical checks are not a universal proof. Literature search cannot establish absolute priority.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous deterministic SEIR with constant stage rates and canonical vanishing-seed outbreak; no statement about arbitrary unmatched finite initial exposed/infectious splits, stochastic or heterogeneous dynamics, or peaks of E+I.
title: Reciprocal latency–recovery duality and the unique SEIR overshoot minimum
